what: The sections of this article, each with a line and a paragraph, for showing what the reader has already read. Built by admin/build/summaries.py from admin/content/articles/summaries/.

sections.label: The opening
sections.line: Turning the 49 browser tools of tools.sgraph.ai into sovereign websites, each with its own team.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: 49 tools and 90 components, one site each, simple first, components pulled out, pinned versions, signed hashes, a team of teams.

sections.label: Every tool was a problem
sections.line: Every tool was a problem I had, and an answer to a web buried in ads and hidden features.

sections.label: What is there
sections.line: Keys and secrets, vaults and sending, AI and agents, audio and video, documents and images, publishing.

sections.label: Why one site each
sections.line: An explorer project slowed; one site each: own address, documented, good-looking, cheap, forkable, with a team.

sections.label: A little intelligence in each
sections.line: A small agent in each tool, with models in the browser or on the device where they can run.

sections.label: The order
sections.line: Wave one simple, already started by the factory; then secrets and vaults, audio and video, AI and agents.

sections.label: Components, pulled out
sections.line: The tools' components become a versioned library each tool pins.

sections.label: Versions, pinned
sections.line: latest/ overwritten at each release, and every release pinned in its own folder with security and architecture.

sections.label: Signed hashes, kept apart
sections.line: Signed manifests of file hashes in a separate repository, so a compromised site shows.

sections.label: A team of teams
sections.line: A tools conductor, family teams, and a team per tool; one brief for a change across many.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: The sites do not exist yet; the hash scheme is a design; counts as of 19 November.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: The SGraph-AI__Tools repository and the factory's requests of 19 November.
